title: Calling for Investments Proposals for the land called Chalmer's Granary located at Olcott Mawatha, Colombo Fort owned by the Urban Development Authority
decision_details: - The land of Chalmers Granary in extent of 09 acres 02 roods 31.75 perches (3.9248 hectares) located at Olcott Mawatha, Colombo Fort, owned by the Urban Development Authority, is located within the Compact Mixed Development Zone of the Development Plan prepared for the Colombo Municipal Council area for the period 2022-2031. It has been found appropriate to dispose the said land on a lease basis for the implementation of a mixed development project with higher financial, environmental and social potential, from among the permissible uses within the Compact Mixed Development Zone, including residential, healthcare, offices and corporate, commercial, educational, customer service centers, tourism, recreational and other activities. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Urban Development, Construction and Housing to invite Investment Proposals from interested investors, to dispose the relevant land on a 99-year lease basis based on the updated valuation of the Chief Government Valuer, was approved by the Cabinet.
